mandatory: Keep exact raw feature duplicate groups together in all splits.
Learn imputers/encodings inside each training partition; descriptive EDA tables are not feature lookup tables.
No neural networks, unlimited-depth trees, external labels, or Kaggle-test inspection.

variant_1_raw_minimal.missing: Native duration NaN when supported; stable categorical missing marker. Airline is redundant with prefix in observed training rows.
variant_1_raw_minimal.hypothesis: Preserve raw signal while avoiding a large bundle of redundant sparse interactions and arbitrary flight-number ordering.

variant_2_parsimonious_interactions.hypothesis: Route has only 30 levels and cabin/prefix price regimes are large; these compact features expose important decision structure.

variant_3_duration_fill_ablation.scope: Only if native missing performs poorly; retain raw duration and duration_missing.
variant_3_duration_fill_ablation.regularization: Require minimum observed support and fall back for uncertain groups; same schedules can differ by 24 hours.
variant_3_duration_fill_ablation.hypothesis: Recovered duration may be useful in large AI/6E business groups; imputation is not an automatic improvement.

not_supported: Global monotone price decrease with days_left.
Dropping high prices as erroneous labels.
Treating numeric flight suffix as an intrinsically ordered economic quantity.
Removing all conflicting duplicate rows or assuming all duplicate conflicts are annotation mistakes.
Using every possible sparse category interaction.
